findings.description: ZZZMembership.settleDust() (src/ZZZMembership.sol#37-64) has external calls inside a loop: position = vault.group(bucket) (src/ZZZMembership.sol#45)
findings.rationale:
count<=Vault.MAX_BUCKETS=4 is checked. Two fixed current pair currencies per relevant bucket; after compositionEpoch!=0, admitted LP reward currencies explicitly<=33. At most33 unique currencies per bucket and132 flush calls across4 buckets, because the current pair is excluded from the historical-asset loop.
Only bound Vault invokes this economic operation. Snapshot bucket count cannot grow by outside reentry while its Vault contribution is nonreentrant. get/group/epoch/asset reads are static. Rewards transfers are exact, liabilities updated and backed. A malicious admitted token could revert; it cannot select a new array or receive a sweep.
Bounded incumbent settlement, not an unbounded per-NFT harvest. Funded broken-token dust can block entry atomically; zero dust returns before token handling. Qualify maximum historical-asset gas and exact token behavior.

	Dangerous comparisons:
	- end == 0 || block.timestamp > end (src/ZZZNFT.sol#139)
findings.rationale: The timestamp is deliberately a sale/eligibility clock, not a random seed or token valuation. Governance may revise a future end only while the old sale is open. Mint is inclusive through end; royalty activation cutoff is strict before end+3600; claims open at/after it. No keeper opening is required. Chain timestamp and pause/outage timing risks remain; wall-clock/marketplace stage matching must be qualified. No administrator extension after closure or silent late-cohort enlargement exists.
findings.review_scope: Unique exact prior fingerprint; every description-referenced source LF-byte-identical

findings.description:
ZZZRoyaltyRewards.activate(uint256,uint256) (src/ZZZRoyaltyRewards.sol#216-248) uses assembly
	- INLINE ASM (src/ZZZRoyaltyRewards.sol#234)
findings.rationale: activate uses a fixed SELF call, fixed syncForActivation selector and current admitted asset, with zero value and governed<=1m forwarding. syncForActivation accepts msg.sender==address(this) only; the outer activate is immutable-NFT-only/nonReentrant/economic. The assembly discards returndata instead of copying malicious revert data. Each failed optional call rolls back its substate and keeps the old eligible prefix; successful activation weights/tickets register once after synchronization. Native ETH does not use an untrusted ERC20 call. Final-source reassessment: bitmap canonical uniqueness retains disjoint ordinal/ticket namespaces, and the shared _forwardRaw/_sendRaw factoring does not relax this path. Recovery/late movement is not income; only RoyaltiesAllocated records new exact allocation.
findings.review_scope: Unique exact prior fingerprint; every description-referenced source LF-byte-identical

findings.description:
ZZZRoyaltyRewards._finalizeOpening() (src/ZZZRoyaltyRewards.sol#145-152) has costly operations inside a loop:

Final-source reassessment: bitmap canonical uniqueness retains disjoint ordinal/ticket namespaces, and the shared _forwardRaw/_sendRaw factoring does not relax this path. ZZZFeesCanonical.canonicalCapture() (src/ZZZFeesCanonical.sol#41-62) has costly operations inside a loop:

findings.rationale:
Prior assets length<=33 by both capture/import headers; deleting accepted flags is<=33 storage writes. New groups<=4 and lpAssets in1..33. New asset arrays replace prior arrays, not append across attempts.
